(async()=>{window.__toolDesign=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(JSON.stringify(window.__toolDesign.project.sheetSet)!==JSON.stringify(window.__designBefore.project.sheetSet))throw Error('Tools changed authored sheets');if(window.__toolDesign.project.walls.length!==4||window.__toolDesign.project.openings.length!==2||window.__toolDesign.project.lines.length!==1||window.__toolDesign.project.roomTags.length!==1)throw Error('Rendered design read differs');document.querySelector('.arch-canvases').scrollIntoView({block:'center'});window.__toolCapture=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='capture_workspace_image').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,target:'architect'});if(window.__toolCapture.isError||window.__toolCapture.content[1]?.type!=='image')throw Error(JSON.stringify(window.__toolCapture));window.__toolCapture.content[0]})()

(async()=>{const r=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='draw_architect_elements').execute(window.__toolDrawArgs);if(!r.isError||!r.content[0].text.includes('revision changed'))throw Error('Stale drawing succeeded');if(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId))!==window.__toolSavedRaw)throw Error('Stale tool overwrote design');r})()

(async()=>{const r=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='draw_architect_elements').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,expectedRevision:window.__toolDesign.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'door',wallRef:window.__toolDesign.project.walls[0].id,offsetMm:100,widthMm:10000,heightMm:2100,tag:'BAD',hinge:'left',swing:'in'}]});if(!r.isError)throw Error('Invalid opening succeeded');if(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId))!==window.__toolSavedRaw)throw Error('Invalid batch changed design');r})()

(async()=>{const r=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(r.project.walls.length||r.project.openings.length||r.project.lines.length||r.project.roomTags.length)throw Error('Real UI undo did not remove batch');'Undo restored original design through saved UI history'})()

(async()=>{window.__toolAfterRedo=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});window.__toolRawBeforeFailure=localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId));window.__originalToolSetItem=Storage.prototype.setItem;Storage.prototype.setItem=function(key,value){if(key==='xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId))throw new DOMException('Tool QA quota refused','QuotaExceededError');return window.__originalToolSetItem.call(this,key,value)};const r=await window.__localTools.find(t=>t.name==='draw_architect_elements').execute({expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,expectedRevision:window.__toolAfterRedo.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'line',levelId:window.__toolAfterRedo.project.levels[0].id,a:[0,2000],b:[8000,2000]}]});Storage.prototype.setItem=window.__originalToolSetItem;if(!r.isError||!r.content[0].text.includes('quota refused'))throw Error('Tool save refusal was not reported');if(localStorage.getItem('xray:architect:v1:'+encodeURIComponent(window.__toolContext.projectId))!==window.__toolRawBeforeFailure)throw Error('Failed tool save changed bytes');return r;})()

(async()=>{await window.__runLocalTool('navigate_workspace',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,pane:'sketch'});const current=await window.__runLocalTool('read_architect_design',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId});if(current.project.revision!==window.__toolAfterRedo.project.revision)throw Error('Reopen lost saved revision');const r=await window.__runLocalTool('draw_architect_elements',{expectedJobId:window.__toolContext.projectId,expectedRevision:current.project.revision,operations:[{kind:'line',levelId:current.project.levels[0].id,a:[0,2000],b:[8000,2000]}]});window.__toolFinalRevision=r.designRevision;return r;})()
